The '''Chandrila Orbital Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that orbited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Located in the [[Chandrila system/Legends|Chandrila system]] in the [[Bormea sector/Legends|Bormea sector]], the station was host to a raid during the [[Battle of the Red Reaper|Battle of the ''Red Reaper'']] where it was defended by the [[Chandrilan Security Force|Chandrilan security force]]s.<ref name="Red Reaper" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Chandrila Orbital Station was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]].
